page.empty: No incoming payments waiting to be matched
page.emptyDescription: Every incoming payment has been matched to a plan invoice or a booking hold.
page.total: {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} in total

filters.searchPlaceholder: Transfer content, extracted code or FT reference

detail.title: Transaction detail
detail.loadError: This transaction could not be opened
detail.rawHint: Evidence in case of a dispute - not editable.

suggestions.title: Match target
suggestions.hint: Pick the item this transfer belongs to - items with the exact amount are listed first.
suggestions.empty: No plan invoice or reservation hold is awaiting payment

match.dialogSummary: {amount} will be recorded against {code} ({tenant}). This is logged and cannot be undone.

ignore.title: Skip this transaction?
ignore.body: The row stays in the ledger as evidence; it only leaves the queue of things to handle.
ignore.refunded: Money has been refunded to the sender
ignore.refundReferenceRequired: Enter the refund reference (at least 3 characters).
ignore.notePlaceholder: e.g. the customer transferred by mistake, confirmed by phone

handle.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the note names the shop but is missing the invoice code

footer.choose: Pick a target on the right to match - or ignore it if it belongs to none.
footer.noInvoice: Nothing is awaiting payment - this transfer can only be ignored or refunded to the customer wallet.

credit.success: Credited to the customer points wallet
credit.dialogSummary: {amount} sent for {code} will be refunded to {customer}'s points wallet. No booking is created - this item is closed. This is logged and cannot be undone.

lateCredit.title: Code {code} of {customer} closed before the money arrived
lateCredit.hint: A closed item cannot become a booking. Refund it with "Credit customer wallet" - the customer withdraws to their bank from the points wallet.
lateCredit.noAccount: This item is not linked to a customer account. Refund the transfer manually, then use "Ignore" with the refund reference.

reasons.hold_not_found: Reservation code {code} does not exist - the customer may have mistyped a character.
reasons.hold_closed: Money arrived after reservation hold {code} closed - credit the customer wallet or refund.
reasons.extension_closed: Money arrived after extension {code} stopped accepting payment - credit the customer wallet or refund.
reasons.checkout_not_found: Plan checkout code {code} does not exist.
reasons.checkout_closed: Money arrived after plan checkout {code} stopped accepting payment - refund the shop.
reasons.invoice_not_found: Plan invoice code {code} does not exist.
reasons.invoice_closed: Money arrived after plan invoice {code} stopped accepting payment - match a new invoice or refund the shop.
reasons.overpaid: Overpaid - the excess was refunded to the points wallet automatically.
